title: Day and night
examples: Teacher, what is up in the sky during the day?
When do we see the moon?
What happens when it gets dark?

explain.say: In the day, the sun is in the sky. The sun gives us light and warmth. It is too bright to look at.
At night, the sky is dark. You may see the moon and stars.
In the day, you play, learn and eat. At night, you sleep.
The Earth spins all the time. It turns around once each day.

items: Your side faces the sun: day

explain.say: When your side of the Earth faces the sun, it is day. When it turns away, it is night.

faq.q: Why does the sun go away at night?
faq.a: The sun stays where it is. The Earth spins, and your side turns away from the sun. Then it is night.
asks: Why is it dark when the sun leaves?

faq.q: Is the moon bright like the sun?
faq.a: No, the moon is much less bright than the sun. The moon shines because sunlight bounces off it.
asks: Does the moon have its own light?

faq.q: What is our routine during the day?
faq.a: During the day, you wake up, play, learn and eat. The sunlight helps you see.
asks: What do we do when the sun is up?
What is a normal day like?

faq.q: Do we sleep when the moon is out?
faq.a: Yes, most people sleep when it is dark at night. This helps our bodies rest and grow strong for the next day.
asks: Is it time for bed when it is dark?
Why do we sleep at night?

faq.q: Are the sun and the moon friends?
faq.a: They are both in the sky, but they are different. The sun is a big star, and the moon orbits around the Earth.
asks: Do the sun and moon talk to each other?
What is the difference between them?

facts: The sun is a star that gives us light and heat.
The moon shines because it reflects the sun's light.
At night, the sky is dark and we see the stars.
Our planet spins, which causes day and night.

quiz.say: Think of the daytime sky. Tap what gives us light and warmth.
quiz.why: The sun gives us light and warmth in the day.

wrong.0: The moon is easiest to see at night, and it gives no warmth.
wrong.2: Clouds can cover the sun and make the day darker.

quiz.say: Look at the bed. Tap the time when most people sleep.
quiz.why: Most people sleep at night, when it is dark.

wrong.1: In the morning, most people wake up.
wrong.2: At lunchtime, it is the middle of the day, and people eat.

quiz.say: Look at the spinning Earth. Tap what the spinning makes.
quiz.why: When your side of the Earth faces the sun, it is day. When it turns away, it is night.

wrong.0: Rain and snow are weather, and they come from clouds.
wrong.1: Wind and clouds are weather, which changes from day to day.
